question: Which of the following institutions won the Bakshi Cup in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Naval Academy (INA)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indian Naval Academy (INA)**, located in **Ezhimala, Kerala**, emerged as the overall champion of the prestigious **Bakshi Cup 2025**.
 
• The tournament was hosted by the **National Defence Academy (NDA)** at **Khadakwasla, Pune**, and was held from **February 14 to February 16, 2025**.
 
• The **Bakshi Cup** is an annual inter-academy sports meet that brings together the four premier officer training institutions of India: **NDA (Pune)**, **IMA (Dehradun)**, **INA (Ezhimala)**, and **AFA (Dundigal)**.
 
• The **INA** contingent showcased exceptional performance across various sports disciplines, securing gold medals in **Basketball**, **Volleyball**, and the grueling **Cross Country** race, which ultimately led to them lifting the championship trophy. ***Hence, the option mentioning Indian Naval Academy is correct.***
